<thought>We need to obtain the possible precursor sets by applying the retrosynthetic template with ID 1014069 to the target molecule COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1. The tool `apply_template` will return all possible outcomes (lists of precursor SMILES). We'll then format the result as a list of lists.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles":"COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1","template_id":"1014069"}</action_input>
